sections.title: Use defaults without top frontmatter
entries: A compound-gpid.local.md file without a top YAML frontmatter block now uses the default cg suite and config schema version 2 in memory only. Empty files, whitespace, and Markdown notes do not need a settings block; the file is not rewritten to insert defaults.

An initial UTF-8 BOM is ignored when reading configuration. Existing top frontmatter still uses strict validation: malformed or unterminated blocks, duplicate or unknown keys, invalid values, and unsupported schema versions remain errors with filename and line diagnostics.
cg-link --check remains read-only: it does not write configuration, project files, or global files. Default-settings handling does not turn checking into migration or repair.

sections.title: Upgrade to 9025
entries: From v1.2.0.9024 on Windows or macOS: outside linked project directories (for example, from your home directory), run cg-update v1.2.0.9025, then run the NEW cg-link once per project, keeping its adapter selection. Use the explicit version, not latest.

From older versions: follow docs/upgrade.md to migrate and install v1.2.0.9024 first, then run cg-update v1.2.0.9025 and the NEW cg-link once per project. Guide: https://github.com/GPID-WB/compound-gpid/blob/v1.2.0.9024/docs/upgrade.md
Keep installation and project backups. If linking reports blocked or preserved files, keep them and review the reported manual action; do not delete adapter folders or use unlink to bypass conflicts.

sections.title: Tests added and publication gates
entries: Tests cover defaults, BOM, strict errors, read-only checking, and Windows/macOS upgrade/update fixtures. The installed 9024 updater runs from a neutral directory before NEW linking in valid-config and legacy-config projects; its in-project stale-manifest guard is unchanged. Coverage additions do not qualify every historical installation or a real Kilo host.

Every four-part vX.Y.Z.N tag is Reserve-only: a non-draft GitHub pre-release with make_latest=false. No Finalize, documentation deployment, or attestation applies. Required payload dates are preparation timestamps, not publication proof. Publication requires green local, push, and FULL CI gates.
